chunks: O Lord, save me and my family from what they do.
ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet pray for in Surah Ash-Shu'ara regarding his family?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a profound supplication by Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) seeking divine deliverance from the specific ridicule of the poets who dominated Meccan public opinion. Shia scholarship often views this as a precursor to the concept of Ismah (infallibility) and divine protection for the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that their spiritual purity requires protection from the corrupting influence of societal mockery and falsehood.
